# Holographic foil material

The holographic foil as a material: the rainbow and glints follow the true viewing angle at each point of the surface, so a card, sticker or logo shimmers as it or the camera moves, with no pointer input needed.

<EffectDemo effect="foil-material" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { foilMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/foil-material';

const effect = foilMaterial({ preset: 'card' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
const clock = new THREE.Clock();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => {
  effect.tick(clock.getDelta());
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.intensity = 0.7`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter       | Type                                                      | Default     | Range    | Description                                                                         |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `intensity`     | number                                                    | `0.7`       | 0 – 1    | How strongly the foil tints the surface.                                            |
| `sheen`         | number                                                    | `0.35`      | 0 – 2    | Foil light added on top, strongest on lit areas.                                    |
| `pattern`       | 'linear' \| 'radial' \| 'cosmos'                          | `'linear'`  |          | Rainbow layout across the surface: straight bands, rings, or bands warped by noise. |
| `scale`         | number                                                    | `1.5`       | 0.1 – 10 | Rainbow repeats per unit of surface (UV or object space).                           |
| `angleResponse` | number                                                    | `1.5`       | 0 – 5    | How far the colors slide as the viewing angle changes.                              |
| `saturation`    | number                                                    | `0.75`      | 0 – 1    | Color saturation of the foil.                                                       |
| `sparkle`       | number                                                    | `0.4`       | 0 – 1    | Density of view-dependent glints.                                                   |
| `speed`         | number                                                    | `0.2`       | 0 – 2    | Drift of the cosmos pattern (stops when motion is off).                             |
| `tint`          | hex color (theme: [`accent`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#ffffff'` |          | Color multiplied into the foil.                                                     |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                                                        |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `card`    | `intensity: 0.8`, `sheen: 0.5`, `sparkle: 0.6`                  |
| `sticker` | `pattern: 'radial'`, `scale: 3`, `sparkle: 0.2`                 |
| `cosmos`  | `pattern: 'cosmos'`, `scale: 2`, `intensity: 0.9`, `sheen: 0.6` |
| `subtle`  | `intensity: 0.35`, `sheen: 0.15`, `sparkle: 0.1`                |

Apply one with `foilMaterial({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Holographic & iridescent · tracked as story X11.1 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `effect.setMotion(false)`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 8.8 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/foil-material`, including the shared effect runtime.
